name: beauty-router
description: Integrates Beauty Router into a salon app step by step: login, the marketplace, verification, orders, and the product catalog, tested in a browser after each step and matched to the app's design. Sets up the sandbox and, when you say yes, production.

interface.longDescription: Reads your salon app, proposes where the Beauty Router marketplace, verification, orders, and catalog go, and builds them one step at a time. After each step it runs your app, tests the new part in a browser, matches it to your design, and opens it for you to try. It ends with a commit or a pull request in your project's style, and sets up production when you say yes.
defaultPrompt: Integrate Beauty Router into this app
